purpose: One bounded, read-only Go dashboard/v1 projection for canonical CLI/MCP and the existing web/SwiftUI Mercury scene. Surface restoration is an unqualified source candidate; no new producer, control authority or release136 gate.

authority.producer: Mercury owns monitor schema, samples, calibration, run state and rates
authority.consumer: internal/mercury reads and presents; never samples or controls a run
prohibited: no new telemetry writer or authority
no current-native or web parity claim from CLI/MCP tests

inputs: producer timestamps, calibration, units and optional-field policy
outputs: typed state, source/read timestamps and immutable per-read snapshot
shared wire, compressed, gain and topology projection
unknown and stale values remain explicit
upgrade_recipe: coordinate schema compatibility with the Mercury owner before widening
preserve bounded HTTP, private-address checks, no proxy and no redirects
preserve cancellation, EOF/oversize, malformed and freshness refusals
do not retain idle connections from per-call clients
run producer fixtures and negative controls before composing any surface
never turn a monitor read into admission or performance qualification

inputs: explicit CLI invocation or zero-argument mercury_status MCP call
outputs: human CLI projection and exact structured JSON read
closed MCP argument schema and runtime argument refusal
upgrade_recipe: keep both surfaces on the same core reader and configuration resolution
keep endpoint selection out of MCP arguments
test explicit empty configuration, default loopback and invalid configuration
do not add surface-local freshness, unit conversion, calibration or caches
preserve optional schema fields for existing MCP tools
add only the exact recipe resource to signed-package inventory
qualify the installed signed successor separately from a development readback

inputs: the same canonical Go Read DTO via GET /api/mercury
shared Go card-edge geometry and formatted headline/rates
local receive wall time plus monotonic elapsed time
outputs: existing-console read-only black/emerald/gold hardware and cable scene
distinct degraded read states, withheld aggregates and eligible partial directions
source run/calibration/provenance details and owned refresh/cancellation
upgrade_recipe: preserve both console doors, strict script-src self and same-origin uncached external assets
retain GET-only context cancellation and no browser endpoint override, proxy or control
never recompute gain, rates, family or topology; use supplied Go geometry and formatting
expire retained display claims with a local clock without making a network request from that clock
qualify actual Go mixed-freshness wire and inert cancellation/late-response fixtures before visual or installed acceptance

inputs: canonical sirsi mercury --json through the existing bounded captured runner
same Go geometry/headline/source metadata and exact Go mixed-freshness wire fixture
producer freshness evidence plus local monotonic elapsed time
outputs: retained original vector hardware/cable scene, shared headline/run state and expandable metadata
eligible partial individuals with unknown incomplete aggregates
separately labelled Ra admission/lane and hardware transport receipts
explicit Power Unknown because dashboard/v1 does not expose power
upgrade_recipe: use the canonical CLI and one visibility-bound SwiftUI task for manual and periodic reads
refuse late superseded/cancelled completions and locally expire retained values/rates/motion
never infer case ports, families, calibration, missing-peer rates or an aggregate
retain Reduce Motion, unknown generic hardware, scrollable wide scene and explicit original narrow-design proof gap
preserve separate Ra/transport scope and source-only versus installed/visual qualification boundaries
run strict Release fixtures with actual Go-exported JSON; fixture rendering is explicit and never launches whole-app probes
